text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One holiday. For some reason, Meisho Doto 
ended up participating in a super-spicy 
eating contest hosted by the shopping 
district—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I thought it was just a street 
survey... I had no idea it was an entry 
form...
choice_data_list: Are you going to withdraw now?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
N-No, if I quit halfway through... I'll 
just be causing trouble for everyone...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I don't know how well I'll do, but I'll do 
my absolute best~.

text_block_list.name: Female Host
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's introduce our challenger! Spice 
master with Latin passion, El Condor 
Pasa!!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Big appetite, blazing speed, El is the 
strongest! I'm gonna dial up the heat with 
my very own Salsa Vida!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOAAAHHH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Female Host
text_block_list.text:
Next up, tackling the spice with pure 
spirit and guts, the hot-blooded big sis, 
Hishi Amazon!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Spicy stuff is my specialty! No matter 
what kind of contest it is, I'm the one 
who'll win!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOHHH--!!!)

text_block_list.name: Female Host
text_block_list.text:
"And finally... Whoa, is she looking a 
little nervous? Her tolerance for 
super-spicy food is an unknown quantity: 
Meisho Doto!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
U-U-Umm... I'll do my abso-looth best! 
...Ugh, I bit my tongue!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after all three shared their own 
unique enthusiasm, the showdown began—

text_block_list.name: Female Host
text_block_list.text:
Now, all contestants will first challenge 
the ultra-spicy ramen! The special chili 
noodles and blood-red broth assail the 
challengers—!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hochaaaah!? What on earth is this!? To 
think there was something in this world 
spicier than Salsa Vida!!

text_block_list.name: Female Host
text_block_list.text:
Next, the extra-spicy chicken wings are 
brought out! An impressive dish piled so 
high you have to look up at it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Gweeeh?! Is the batter entirely made of 
chili peppers?! The spice feels like it's 
gonna tear my tongue right off...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, now that you mention it... maybe it 
is a little spicy? But it's so yummy~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Whaaat!? You call this "a little spicy"?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Going toe-to-toe with this extreme spice 
without backing down a single step... Just 
what kind of training have you been 
doing!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
N-N-No, it's not anything amazing like 
training or anything at all!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm just clumsy! I've been accidentally 
ordering spicy food by mistake for years, 
so my tongue is just used to it, that's 
all!

text_block_list.name: Female Host
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, this is an unexpected turn of 
events! Meisho Doto's calm composure has 
left everyone around her flustered~! And 
right here—

text_block_list.name: Female Host
text_block_list.text:
Here comes the final item on the menu: 
piping-hot, ultra-spicy Mapo Tofu! Now, 
just how fast can it be finished?! Time 
for the final push!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose when it comes to late-race 
bursts! On the final stretch, I'll blast 
through at full speed!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Nwooo, I'm all fired up for a battle of 
speed!! Accelerating, super fast, El is 
ultra-hypersonic-speed!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fuehh... I'm not good at eating quickly... 
at allll. What should I do, Trainerrrr... 
*sniff*.
choice_data_list:
Don't rush—just keep going at your current 
pace.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I k-kinda feel like we might lose that 
way... B-But, understood!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Gwaaaah, no way! This is way too spicy! 
Gimme a sec to catch my breath!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Uggghhh, it hurts El's pride to admit it, 
but... Water! Water, please!!

text_block_list.name: Female Host
text_block_list.text:
And right here, both competitors call for 
time simultaneously. Taking advantage of 
that opening... what in the world!? What 
is thissss!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Puhaa... Thank you for the meal. It was 
delicious~.

text_block_list.name: Female Host
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto has cleaned her plate!!! With 
overwhelming dominance, she crosses the 
finish line!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Sticking to her eating pace was the right 
call. With her bottomless tolerance for 
spicy food, Meisho Doto pulled off a 
magnificent victory!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeeek...!!! I-I'll hurry right up!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wait, eeeeek, the plate!? Th-The water 
glass is falling tooooo~?!?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CRASH-BASH-CLATTERRR!)

text_block_list.name: Female Host
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaah, contestant Meisho Doto has 
overturned the dishes! A devastating time 
loss!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hawaaaa~~, I-I'm so sorry! It didn't 
crack, did it? I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
W-Why am I like this? My hand had to slip 
at such an important moment...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, amidst all this chaos, Hishi 
Amazon and El Condor Pasa finished their 
food at the exact same time. And then—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You were strong... If it hadn't been for 
that trouble, you would've won.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I agree, yees! I will train even harder, 
so please give me a rematch, yeees!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
H-Hawawa, someone like me getting that...? 
I-It's an honooor~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The three shake hands. Having earned the 
respect of strong rivals, Meisho Doto 
gained a little confidence.
